findings.evidence: `Standard.lean:47` defines `stdRep`; `Restriction.lean:46` establishes the nearby convention by defining `stdSLRep := (stdRep k n).comp Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL`; Mathlib `UnitaryGroup.lean:218` confirms `embeddingGL` targets `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup`, not `Matrix.GL`.
findings.fix: Define the monoid embedding `orthogonalGroup (Fin n) k →* GL (Fin n) k` (transporting `UnitaryGroup.embeddingGL` through `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin.symm`), define `stdOrthogonalRep` as `stdRep k n` composed with it, and derive injectivity and character from `stdRep_injective` and `char_stdRep`.
findings.issue: `stdOrthogonalRep` directly composes `Units.coeHom` with the linear `UnitaryGroup.embeddingGL`, so the PR omits the roadmap's orthogonal-to-matrix-GL inclusion and duplicates the general standard representation's faithfulness and character arguments at lines 93 and 167.

summary: The representation is rebuilt at a special-case level instead of being the promised restriction of the existing standard representation.
